name: ADEZ XMD
description: ADEZ XMD is a WhatsApp bot with a terminal-style menu, group tools and fun commands.

SESSION_ID.description: Session ID from the pair page. Keep it private: anyone with it can control the linked WhatsApp account.

BOT_NAME.description: Name shown on the menu and in the startup alert

PREFIX.description: Single command prefix (e.g. . or !). Leave empty to use the defaults . ! /

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp number with country code, no + sign. Owner commands stay disabled until this is set.

MODE.description: Who can use the bot: public or private

TIMEZONE.description: Timezone for the startup alert, e.g. Africa/Nairobi
